verdict.rationale: Programmatic or headless automation is a fair question for an online company-incorporation service, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only an interactive web flow: authentication by Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital, a professional certificate or eIDAS, digital signature of the pact by every partner, and payment via MBWay, Multibanco or card. Nothing in the pack mentions an API, CLI or any way to run the process unattended or in CI.
